senses.gloss: m. (Ithpe. noun of סמך; cmp. סוּמְכָא) the thick part, or the protection of an organ of the body, muscle, cartilage &c.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 50b:2">Ḥull. 50ᵇ</cite> (explaining ‘the inner stomach’) <he>א׳ דכרסא</he> (Ar. <he>אסט׳</he>) the thick portion of the rumen (?).
Ab. Zar. 29ᵃ א׳ דליבא the protector of the heart (or of the stomach), the cartilago ensiformis, xiphoides, v. אוּנְקְלַי I, 3; (other opinion rejected in Rashi: fleshy walls of the heart).
